title: scribbit-fee-oracle server environment
description: Environment of the optional fee server (src/main.ts, parsed by src/config.ts). One process serves one network. At least one source variable (MEMPOOL_URLS, MEMPOOL_BLOCKS_URLS, ESPLORA_URLS, BITCOIND_RPC_URL, STATIC_FEE_RATE) is required. Values are strings, as in any environment.

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated allowed origins, or * (fee data is public and read-only).

MEMPOOL_URLS.description: Comma-separated mempool.space-compatible base URLs (network prefix included, e.g. https://mempool.space/signet) polled at /api/v1/fees/recommended. Prefer the self-hosted backend first.

MEMPOOL_BLOCKS_URLS.description: Comma-separated mempool.space-compatible base URLs polled at /api/v1/fees/mempool-blocks (projected blocks; also yields the block-lane displacement rate).

ESPLORA_URLS.description: Comma-separated Esplora base URLs polled at /fee-estimates.

LIBRE_RELAY_RPC_URL.description: Libre Relay node JSON-RPC URL: the block-lane source (relay floor + estimatesmartfee) for non-standard block-sized reveals.

BLOCK_LANE_TARGET.description: estimatesmartfee target used by the Libre Relay source.

STATIC_FEE_RATE.description: Fixed sat/vB for every target (regtest/dev only; refused on mainnet).

MIN_RELAY_FEE_RATE.description: Configured min relay floor (sat/vB) applied to every output.

BLOCK_LANE_RECOMMENDED_TARGET.description: Standard target the block-lane recommendation falls back to when no source reports one.

FEE_MAX_STALE_SECONDS.description: How long past TTL the last aggregate may be served (stale: true) while every source fails.

SOURCE_STALE_AFTER_SECONDS.description: A source with no success for this long is reported stale.
